reviews.author: Ch Chaitanya
reviews.text:
I visited Aditya Skin & Laser Center, Guntur for a simple problem: tan on my nose. Instead of giving proper treatment, the doctor unnecessarily stretched it into a 4-week treatment plan. Even after completing those 4 weeks, there was no improvement at all.

After that, the doctor carelessly applied a chemical peel on my face without proper explanation or professionalism. My tan did not reduce even slightly—in fact, two new black spots appeared on my face because of this treatment.

When I questioned the doctor about these new black spots, her response was shocking and completely unacceptable. She said, “I don’t know why this happened, I can’t understand.”
If a doctor cannot understand the side effects of the treatment they themselves are giving, then why are they treating patients at all?

This shows a total lack of responsibility, professionalism, and accountability. Patients come with trust, not to be used for experiments. I am extremely disappointed and mentally stressed because of this experience.

I strongly do NOT recommend this clinic to anyone. Please think twice before visiting this place for any skin treatment. Your skin and your trust deserve better.

Note : i visited 2023 deember still i am suffering with that bad treatement so people dont go to this hospital.
